beats.text: Six things successful people tend to do before 8am.
One. They wake at a consistent time — the body rewards rhythm more than extra sleep-ins.
Two. They don't touch their phone first. They own the first hour before the world claims it.
Three. They move — a walk, a stretch, a workout. The body wakes the mind.
Four. They do the most important task first, while focus is at its freshest.
Five. They take a few quiet minutes — to plan, to pray, to journal, to just think.
Six. They decide the day's one priority, so the hours don't get spent on everyone else's.
Win the morning, the old saying goes, and you win the day. It's less about 5am than about intention.
